==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will cast Resilient Weapon to overwrite non-defensive weapon spells when the target's [[health]] is at critical levels.

== Notes ==
* The +24 armor rating will [[Damage reduction|reduce damage]] by ~34%; combines well with [[Ghost Forge Insignia]] for +15 armor rating to reduce damage by ~50%.
* If [[Lightning Surge]] ends and is the last hex, the damage is still reduced.

== Trivia ==
* This skill icon is very similar to the icon for [[Vital Weapon]].
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
